question: What division of eight octads is sought to be known fully?
premises: There is a division into eight octads.
The speaker seeks to know it fully.
The knowing is sought without end.
inference: The speaker seeks to know fully and endlessly the division of the eight octads.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the eight octads is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: And I wish to know fully and endlessly the division of the eight octads.
